nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How can the findings from Campbell (2005) on the Romantic Ethic and the Spirit of Modern Consumerism be applied in the context of ethical consumer behaviour?
nodes.answer: The findings from Campbell (2005) on the Romantic Ethic and the Spirit of Modern Consumerism can be applied to understand the relationship between consumer behaviour and ethics in purchase decisions.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Minimalist lifestyles|Conscious consumerism_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is needed for conscious consumption to reach the inflection point of the adoption curve?
nodes.answer: Conscious consumption needs to reach the inflection point of the adoption curve to have autonomous growth unrelated to stimuli, as per Rogers (1983).

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What factors have been debated in relation to green purchase intention and behaviour?
nodes.answer: Factors such as conscious behaviour, consumer scepticism, and green loyalty have been debated in relation to green purchase intention and behaviour in the past, highlighting the complexity of consumer attitudes towards sustainability.
